correctness.rationale: The explicit Pólya urn path probability proves each subtree size has probability 1/(n-1); conditional on colours, independent parent choices inside each colour are uniform. The root boundary correction is exact. Leaf count satisfies the Eulerian insertion recurrence and equals cyclic-descent count. The rth cyclic cumulant is m times a constant when m>r because only connected r-edge patterns contribute, all proper paths of the same law, and each has exactly m rotations. Cumulant additivity proves all stated moment equalities. Conditional total leaf count cannot equal 1 at interior splits while one path yields unconditional probability 1/(n-1)!, proving difference. Boundary means give covariance -(n-2)/(2(n-1)). Verification/check.py passed 202 independently computed exact-rational assertions from 46,232 enumerated trees, n=3..9. Enumeration is not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: The motivating gap concerns how a specified entire descendant branch constrains the global leaf profile. The explicit convolution detects a two-component decomposition; all interior splits have exactly the same initial low-order moments as the unconditional whole tree, for an arbitrarily high chosen order as n grows, although a positive-probability one-leaf event separates the distributions. The covariance is wholly generated by two boundary split sizes. This resolves a nontrivial and natural dependence/moment-detection question rather than merely an isolated coefficient or routine mean.
